suggestions: Pre-filter a large table as a Materialized View before the query
reached_sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_store_sales_item AS
SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
JOIN store_sales ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11 AND item.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id;

SELECT * FROM mv_store_sales_item ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id LIMIT 100
